mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, openid, total_amount, pending_amount, withdrawn_amount, create_time, update_time FROM t_commission_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_commission_summary (user_id, openid, total_amount, pending_amount, withdrawn_amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{openid}, #{totalAmount}, #{pendingAmount}, #{withdrawnAmount})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_commission_summary SET pending_amount = pending_amount - #{amount}, withdrawn_amount = withdrawn_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(total_amount - withdrawn_amount - pending_amount, 0) FROM t_commission_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId}
